content: Those who have a 'why' to live, can bear with almost any 'how'.
author: Viktor Frankl
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Living in pretense takes an enormous amount of mental energy. When you constantly manage impressions to please others, you end up feeling like an imposter in your own skin.

Across his life and work, Viktor Frankl saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Honesty with yourself can feel uncomfortable at first, but it is the only ground upon which a real life can be built. When you stop lying to yourself about your feelings, your energy is immediately freed up.
reflectionPrompt: What current difficulty or obstacle are you facing that could become your greatest training ground?
